root_causes.description: The product-catalog pod is CPU-saturated (~2.03 cores peak, roughly 65x the checkout pod's 0.03 cores) while remaining error-free, a classic CPU-burn/starvation signature. This starvation stalls the product-catalog leaf (multi-second request latencies), whose downstream callers (recommendation, frontend, checkout) then time out and emit UNAVAILABLE gRPC errors, matching the OtelDemoTelemetryAbsent watchdog.

evidence.expected_baseline: peer comparison: product-catalog is ~65x higher at peak

evidence.query_or_id: search_traces service_name=product-catalog error_only=True -> traces 61aea6d30a53f949, ef777f8485eb539a, a5c2a9fb7975fe6d
evidence.observed_value: 20 traces, 0 with errors, p95_duration=49503ms; user_browse_product=15001ms, user_get_recommendations=15001ms, user_view_cart=15000ms
evidence.expected_baseline: sub-second p95 for a healthy catalog lookup

evidence.observed_value: error=100; StatusCode.UNAVAILABLE: failed to connect to all addresses (_InactiveRpcError in Python gRPC downstream caller)

evidence.query_or_id: Failed to pull image "gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest": rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded
evidence.observed_value: Error: ErrImagePull count=5; BackOff: Back-off pulling image count=20

root_causes.description: Alternatively the injected fault manifests primarily as a latency spike on product-catalog: trace p95 of ~49.5s and 15s per request, propagated to recommendation/frontend which then fail with UNAVAILABLE while product-catalog's own server error rate stays at zero.

evidence.query_or_id: search_traces service_name=product-catalog error_only=True -> traces 61aea6d30a53f949, ef777f8485eb539a, a5c2a9fb7975fe6d

evidence.expected_baseline: steady non-zero catalog server request rate

root_causes.description: Checkout shows container recreate/restart activity (Created/Started events and a restart delta ~1.1) that could disrupt request handling, but its error rate and CPU usage are not anomalous, so this is a weaker explanation for absent telemetry.

evidence.expected_baseline: 0 restarts over 5m for a stable pod

evidence.query_or_id: Created: Container created (count=3); Started: Container started (count=3)
evidence.expected_baseline: single container creation per pod lifetime

remediation_steps: Confirm CPU saturation on the product-catalog pod: kubectl top pod -n otel-demo -l app.kubernetes.io/name=product-catalog and compare usage against its requests/limits.
If a cpu_stress/CPU-burn fault is injected against product-catalog, stop the fault injection (chaos harness / flagd) to relieve core starvation.
Horizontally scale product-catalog replicas and/or raise its CPU limits so it can absorb load without multi-second request stalls.
Verify downstream recovery: recommendation/frontend/checkout UNAVAILABLE (_InactiveRpcError) logs should cease and product-catalog span p95 should return to sub-second.
Investigate and fix the pause-image ErrImagePull/BackOff events (gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest) so pod sandbox creation does not fail and telemetry export resumes.
